title: Add Group To Model Object Component
description: Add a new Grasshopper scripting component GroupToModelObjectComponent that does the reverse of ModelObjectToGroupComponent. It takes a single GH_GeometryGroup input (Param_Group) and outputs a list of Rhino ModelObjects (Param_ModelObject) by recursively extracting all leaf geometry from the group and wrapping each as a RhinoModelObjectData. Add a utility method in the Utility class to support this conversion. Add tests in the existing Tests.cs file.
summary: Added GroupToModelObjectComponent as the reverse of ModelObjectToGroupComponent. Takes a single GH_GeometryGroup input (Param_Group, nickname "Gr") and outputs a list of Rhino ModelObjects (Param_ModelObject, nickname "Mo*") by recursively extracting leaf geometry from the group document. Added Utility.ExtractRhinoModelObjectDataFromGeometryGroup public method and private ExtractRhinoModelObjectDataFromGeometricGoo helper for recursive traversal. Added GroupToModelObjectComponentTests in Tests.cs. Also updated NamingConventionTests to exclude ScriptingComponent subclasses which intentionally use descriptive arrow-style nicknames instead of the 3-char entity component convention.
